notes: Generated through Asset Foundry using a /goal-style prompt.
Scene contains 20 named samurai: 10 Takeda and 10 Uesugi, staged in opposing ranks on a Japanese countryside battlefield.
Outputs include a single scene GLB, source blend, warrior manifest, and repeatable review camera contact sheet.

identity_acceptance: manifest contains exactly takeda-01 through takeda-10 and uesugi-01 through uesugi-10, or an explicitly documented equivalent stable ID set
all 20 warriors have faction, pose, position, and yaw metadata
Takeda and Uesugi lines are visibly distinguishable by armor/banner palette and formation
review_contract.iteration_policy: Render the same five battlefield cameras after every significant change; compare against the previous best contact sheet; repair the least realistic visible issue before declaring the pack review-ready.
visual_acceptance: scene reads as Japanese countryside battlefield with terrain variation, road, paddies/river, hills/cedars, banners, and dawn lighting
warriors are not blocky/Minecraft-like and do not collapse into indistinguishable low-detail cubes at line cameras
armor silhouettes show helmet, mask, shoulder plates, lamellar rows, weapons, and sashimono banners
